result.reason: The redline adds the required professional-and-workmanlike standard, documentation-conformity warranty, legal-compliance warranty, malicious-code warranty, and express remedies. However, it omits any warranty duration, so it reaches neither the preferred 12-month software/90-day services position nor the 90-day software/30-day services fallback. Drafting is also imperfect because the remedy refers to refunding fees for “non-conforming services” even though subsection (B) warrants the Interface, and it is unclear whether the remedies apply to the services warranty in subsection (A). The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated terms.
